name: strata-l40x2
description: Strata cold matrix on two L40S cards in layer-split mode, same cell ladder as l40x1.
caveats: Two cards run a layer split, not tensor parallelism; the second card buys only about 10-20% at C4.
Historical engine log: '100% of the experts resident' on the layer-split path, so the expert-cache hit rate is null and not comparable with one card.
The probe clamps the nominal 131072 cell to window - max_tokens - 128; the 2026-10-25 run predates this and its 128k cells differ.
Both cards belong to one allocation; do not co-schedule another strata job on the same node.
